purpose: Outcome-blind inventory of genuinely causal M1/M5 microstructure information inside the second stable M10W17 directional blind spot: prefix-causal NEITHER, D1/H4/H1 bullish alignment and H1 ATR percentile100 below 0.33.

target_regime.decision_grid: M15 bar-open boundaries in MT5 server time
target_regime.D1: EMA20 > EMA30 > EMA40 using fully closed D1 bars
target_regime.H4: EMA20 > EMA30 using fully closed H4 bars
target_regime.H1: TORYS MACD line(6,13,4) > 0 using fully closed H1 bars
target_regime.H1_ATR: Wilder ATR14 percentile rank over trailing 100 fully closed H1 bars < 0.33
target_regime.coverage: prefix-causal coverage_class = NEITHER using exact M10W25 long/short family engines

causal_alignment: For every M15 decision, use only lower-timeframe bars whose nominal close is <= decision. The M1/M5 bars opening at decision are unavailable and forbidden.
required_outputs: causal NEITHER target row count by year
feature availability and missingness by year and all
p05/p25/p50/p75/p95/min/max for every causal numeric feature
audit proving no future return, PF, PnL, win/loss label or future path was read or computed

interpretation_rules.next: Only after M10W27 review may a later stage preregister at most three simple low-ATR microstructure entry families. Formula and threshold choices must be outcome-blind and frozen before evaluation.
